create_LibrariesResource: create a LibrariesResource instance to configure HuggingFace datasets library settings
allocate_LibrariesResource: allocate a LibrariesResource to set HF endpoint, disable download counts, and set critical verbosity
release_LibrariesResource: release a LibrariesResource to restore previous HF endpoint, download counts, and verbosity settings
build_LibrariesResource_context: build a context-managed LibrariesResource for isolated HuggingFace datasets configuration
test_LibrariesResource_allocate_release: test the LibrariesResource allocate and release methods for proper state management
